async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Orders page using the relative URL
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales/order/')
    # Wait for the page to load completely
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Filter by status 'Canceled'
    # Find the combobox for status; it might have a name like 'Status'
    await page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has=page.get_by_text('Status')).select_option('canceled')
    # Apply the filter by clicking the 'Search' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    # Wait for the filtered results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by purchase date descending to get the most recent order
    # Click the column header for 'Purchase Date'
    await page.get_by_role('columnheader').filter(has=page.get_by_text('Purchase Date')).click()
    # Wait for the sort to apply
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Extract the date from the first row
    # Get the first row in the table body
    first_row = page.get_by_role('rowgroup').last.get_by_role('row').first
    # Find the date cell (assuming it's the first cell with date info)
    date_cell = first_row.get_by_role('cell').first
    # Get the text content of the date cell
    date_text = await date_cell.text_content()
    # Return the date text
    return date_text
